description: Copy this file to AGENTS.appetite.json or org/<customer>/appetite.json and edit it. It is the deploying organization's risk appetite, not a NoéMI moral rank. Fetch-on-Demand and named refusal criteria are the recommended default stack. Consequence classes are descriptive labels. Attestations are a log of who accepted a difference; they do not change the reporter's exit code.

attestations.reason: Interactive sessions use the organization gateway. Reference workflows keep the upstream pin.
